chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Abdullah al-Barqi, from al-Sarrad, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
I said to him, 'I sell weapons.' He said, 'Do not sell them during the tribulation.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on selling weapons during times of tribulation according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a critical legal principle for preventing the escalation of civil strife by controlling the flow of arms. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the importance of 'sadd al-dhara'i' (blocking the means) to ensure weapons are not utilized by opposing factions during periods of political instability. The specific mention of 'fitnah' highlights the temporal nature of this prohibition, linking commercial activity directly to the broader socio-political context of the community.
